purpose: Reusable deterministic operator layer for the 44 Steve Nison confirmation rules

operators.trend_context: Read existing trend evidence only; never infer direction from Nison alone.
operators.candle_count: Validate required number of candles in the pattern window.
operators.candle_color: Validate bullish/bearish/white/black candle color from OHLC.
operators.open_relation: Compare opens only where the source explicitly requires the relationship.
operators.close_relation: Compare closes only where the source explicitly requires the relationship.
operators.body_geometry: Evaluate real-body relationships; qualitative source wording must remain NOT_EVALUABLE until source-locked.
operators.high_low_relation: Evaluate high/low ordering and breakout relationships.
operators.window_gap: Detect and track Window/Gap state without lookahead.
operators.support_resistance: Consume existing S/R evidence; do not create independent direction.
operators.swing_structure: Evaluate source-defined peak/bottom structures from completed data only.
operators.confirmation_state: Emit confirmation evidence only; never LONG/SHORT or confidence uplift by itself.
